bracket_length = 80.0
bracket_height = 50.0
bracket_thickness = 8.0
step_height = 20.0
step_width = 30.0
slope_angle = 15.0
fillet_radius = 3.0
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_spacing = 40.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (bracket_length, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (bracket_length, bracket_height))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (bracket_length - step_width, bracket_height))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (bracket_length - step_width - step_height * 0.2679, bracket_height - step_height))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (bracket_length - step_width - step_height * 0.2679 - step_width, bracket_height - step_height))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, bracket_height - step_height))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_thickness)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

hole_r = hole_diameter / 2
hole_h = bracket_thickness + 10
for x, y in [(bracket_length/2 - hole_spacing/2, bracket_height/2),
             (bracket_length/2 + hole_spacing/2, bracket_height/2)]:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, bracket_thickness/2) * Cylinder(hole_r, hole_h)

part = solid_body
part.name = "bracket"
